opening.argument: The title identifies an official music video, and the footage centers on a young man in domestic and outdoor scenes. Its repeated lyrics address avoiding imagined problems and fear, while the closing shifts to ordinary entertainment promotion: a Max Korzh show, a new album, and ticket information. Together, these elements present a performer and narrative song rather than a deceptive offer or unsupported promise.
